subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a play written by Shakespeare?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Candlestand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"The Candlestand"** is a play written by **Debeshi Gooptu.**
 
• Shakespeare's works consist of about** 39 plays, 154 sonnets, two long narrative poems, and a few other verses.**
 
• His plays have been translated into every major living language and are performed more often than those of any other playwright.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Antony and Cleopatra
 A tragedy by William Shakespeare.
 
 

 The Comedy of Errors
 A comedy by William Shakespeare.
 
 

 Othello
 A tragedy by William Shakespeare.
